decisions.reason: Core transactional email service with prominent home-page placement and no negative signals, so its option value remains high and keeping costs are justified.
Document capture service shows a concrete adoption result, indicating resolved value, so the option should be kept.
Email-to-fax conversion addresses a declining fax market and has only been mentioned, making its option value unlikely to justify further commitment.
Fax delivery optimization is a feature tied to declining fax usage and lacks prominence, so its option value is low and resources are better reallocated.
Email sandbox threat protection serves growing security needs and remains uncertain, so its option value justifies keeping it open.
